pages.text: SYN Market Wire analyst note on Jangwa Retail (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 164.97 for JAN1. The note cites steady demand in the retail sector and cost control at Jangwa Retail (SYN). The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
